title: docs(releases/v19): list the grid's staged edit retirement among the migrated breaking changes

## 维护者速读
- 升级到 19 的应用团队打开 v19 发布页，在「自动迁移」的破坏性变更清单里能看到表格暂存编辑方式已退役：没有了「全部保存」栏，每格提交即保存，以及宿主代码要删什么、改传什么。
- 属于 v19 升级说明这条线，替读发布页升级的团队提前知道表格行为变了，而不是从用户那里听说。
- 只加一条清单和一句统计口径说明，不改任何行为；写错了也只是文字，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx`, 自动迁移 → **Keys retired or refused at parse**: one bullet for the grid's staged edit retirement, right after the `object-grid` `singleClickEdit` bullet (the same select-first model). It says what retired, what an editable grid does now (no "Save All" bar, each committed cell saved on its own), and what a host drops (`cellSelection={false}`, `onBatchSave`, `data-table`'s `singleClickEdit`) and passes instead (`onRowSave`). It links #35827 and PR #37437 and names the registered entry `data-table-staged-edit-retired`.
- Same file, **How this list was built**: one sentence saying this entry landed after the `a46efa8c` measurement the page's counts come from, so the 102 / 71 / 31 figures stay as measured and the extra bullet is accounted for.
- The bullet does not name the cell-selection host component: in-flight #38129 is correcting that name in the changeset and CHANGELOGs, and the page stays out of its way.
- No changeset (content/docs only). No release PR touched.

## Tests
- Docs only; no tests change.

<details><summary>Readings at 2f5689b5 (base origin/main 7605e0c9)</summary>

- Premise at 7605e0c9: in the page's two breaking sections, `staged`, `37437`, `35827`, `cellSelection` and `onBatchSave` had zero hits in any bullet; `data-table-staged-edit-retired` and #37437 appeared only in the 自动迁移 intro (added by #37916).
- `5dbcc02` (the #37437 merge) is not an ancestor of `a46efa8c` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 1), so the page's measured counts do not include it.
- The retirement shipped in `19.0.0-next.0`: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/CHANGELOG.md` carries `5dbcc02` under `## 19.0.0-next.0` with the registered-entry marker for `data-table-staged-edit-retired`; the entry lives in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.data-table-staged-edit-retired.ts`.

- Derived local gate set at 2f5689b5: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 52 derived, 52 run, 0 NOT MEASURED; all 52 exit 0 (record: `/mnt/project-files/card-37922/gates-ran-2f5689b5.list` in the project folder). `check:role-word` exit 0 as the seat asked.
- Five gates first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and exit 0 after their prerequisite: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture` and `check:docs-transcript-drift` after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/lint...`; `@objectstack/spec check:docs` after `gen:schema`; `check:skill-examples` after building `@objectstack/client-react` with declarations.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --base origin/main`: 3 citations added, 2 resolve as pull requests and 1 as an issue, exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Out of scope, handed to the seat (it files them as a separate card): the page lists only changesets pending at `a46efa8c`, and a rough grep of `.changeset/pre` finds about 27 breaking or registered changesets added after it across `19.0.0-next.0`..`next.2`; the page header says no 19.x is published while npm's `next` tag reads `19.0.0-next.2`.

## Verification
Read first:
1. `content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx`, the new bullet under "Keys retired or refused at parse".
2. The same file, the added sentence at the end of "How this list was built".

Two-minute check: `git show origin/main:content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx | grep -c 37437` prints 1 (the intro only); on this branch the same grep on the file prints 3.
